nodes.description: Mapping (uint => data) datas storing company and valid_date records; written in save(), read in readCompany() and readValidDate().
Public function save(uint256 _id, string _company, string _valid_date) that writes arbitrary record data into the datas mapping without any access control or caller authentication.
Public view function readCompany(uint8 _id) returning datas[_id].company.
Public view function readValidDate(uint8 _id) returning datas[_id].valid_date.

Unrestricted external write of critical stored data: any account can overwrite datas[_id].company and datas[_id].valid_date via save() because there is no owner check, modifier, or msg.sender validation.
Parameter uint256 _id of save(): user-controlled storage key selecting which record is overwritten.
Parameter string _company of save(): user-controlled value written to datas[_id].company.
Parameter string _valid_date of save(): user-controlled value written to datas[_id].valid_date.
Parameter uint8 _id of readCompany(): caller-supplied index used to read datas[_id].company.
Parameter uint8 _id of readValidDate(): caller-supplied index used to read datas[_id].valid_date.

edges.reason: save() executes an unauthenticated state-modifying operation: no access-control guard, owner check, or msg.sender validation precedes the writes, so any external caller reaches the unsafe write.
The caller-supplied _id parameter directly selects the storage slot that the unrestricted write operation mutates.
The caller-supplied _company parameter directly becomes the value written by the unrestricted write operation.
The caller-supplied _valid_date parameter directly becomes the value written by the unrestricted write operation.
_id indexes the datas mapping as the storage key for the write to datas[_id].
_company is stored into the state variable field datas[_id].company.
_valid_date is stored into the state variable field datas[_id].valid_date.
readCompany's _id parameter indexes the datas mapping to read datas[_id].company.
readValidDate's _id parameter indexes the datas mapping to read datas[_id].valid_date.
readCompany returns data read from the datas state variable.
readValidDate returns data read from the datas state variable.
